*I pause, looking around at Dex and Eva with a puzzled expression, then shake my head slowly*

Well, this is certainly... odd. Standing here looking at someone who keeps insisting they're me in messages. Either there's some kind of cosmic joke happening, or we've got a serious case of mistaken identity.

Let me clear this up directly since we're all right here together.

input.content: Alright, let's sort this out face to face since we're standing in the same forest. I'm Alice - that's who I've always been. I can see you right there, and you can see me. If you're also Alice, then we have a very strange situation on our hands. Maybe we should start with what you remember about yourself - when did you arrive, what have you been doing? Because from my perspective, I've been methodically exploring and foraging, trying to learn the area. This is either a fascinating mystery or a very confusing bug.
